text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opinion and repeated stance","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position directly and keeps returning to the same overall claim about supporting driverless cars with conditions."},{"evidence":"“if the idea ... isn't executed correctly” and “if ... able to choose when the car was driverless”","quality":"qualifying nuance","description":"The essay develops a more conditional argument by acknowledging limits and specifying what would need to be true before it fully supports the cars."},{"evidence":"“I could take naps on long roadtrips” and “save money then I'm all for it”","quality":"personal support","description":"The essay connects its position to concrete personal benefits, which makes the argument feel more grounded and persuasive."},{"evidence":"opening, middle, and closing paragraphs with transitions like “But,” “However,” and “With all that being said”","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a clearer argumentative structure that moves from claim to reasons to conclusion in an orderly way."},{"evidence":"“100% trustworthy and able to drive JUST like a human”","quality":"development of claims","description":"The essay expands its reasons with explanation of what safety and usability would require, rather than just stating opinions."}]}
